author: Fable (brief 011; GDD v0.22.0 §04, §07, §09, §10, §14)
rule: The words of the Handover, made at build time and read by the Unity host; nothing here is written live and no line decides anything (GDD §09: text is a light layer, history is what the systems record). The host finds a line with lookup() and picks a variant with pickIndex() (contracts/missions/handover/text.schema.ts): same seed and same run, same words. Keys follow the engine: verbs are the panel verb ids, outcomes the rulebook outcomes (`suspicious` when the person reports the approach), refusals are text codes found by lockOf() because the engine returns free text. People are named only Inez and Vale; everyone else is a role. Civilians are never the payload: no line asks a civilian to die, fight or be used as a weapon. Lines that name Halcyon are pending Sky (a Story proposal): ship the `unnamed` cliffhanger until Sky decides. What the Story spine says Inez keeps from the guard is parked (Sky, 2026-10-15) and appears nowhere.

tone.world: An alternate 1950s that found atomic power centuries ago: 1950s manners and speech, centuries-ahead machines, no thinking machines or networks. Optimistic on the surface, coercive underneath: the city is polite, orderly and watching. Speech is plain, short and spoken; no period slang to dress it up, no modern internet speech.

voices.scout: terse and observant: fragments, what is where, counts and positions; never warm, never wrong
voices.fixer: warm and persuasive: reassures, says "we", puts people at ease; steel under the kindness
voices.tech: calm and practical: procedure, minutes and what is tied to what; patient, a little dry about old wiring
voices.enforcer: dry, older, few words: one to four words where he can; gallows humour, never a speech
voices.waitress: Inez: warm café patter, quick, tired about money and the lender; her temperament shows in what she will and won't take
voices.driver: Vale's official driver: gruff and practical; cars, wages, schedules; calls Vale "the Councillor"
voices.guard: the door guard: officialese, clipped, the post and the rules; a mercenary one talks bonuses and "off the clock"
voices.councillor: Vale: formal and pompous, then frightened; loyal blusters, mercenary bargains, fearful begs
voices.rivals: cold and businesslike: a contract, a schedule, no names
voices.patrol: a clockwork patrol: fixed polite phrases that mean orders ("Walking is encouraged. Running is reported.")
voices.security: the response unit: crisp, loud, procedural
voices.watcher: a person in the camera room, speaking into a handset: reports what the camera shows
voices.crowd: passers-by: startled, short, human; they never fight and are never used

pick.rule: variant index for the n-th use (0-based) of a key in a run: for i = 0..n, at = fnv1a32(seed + "|" + key + "|" + i) mod count, and if at equals the previous use's variant (count > 1) then at = (at + 1) mod count. fnv1a32 is the rulebook's (contracts/rules/rulebook.ref.ts, 32-bit FNV-1a over the UTF-16 code units). The key is event/verb/speaker/outcome/temperament/about with absent parts skipped; `seed` is the run's seed string. The line is the entry lookup() finds: every field an entry names must equal the query's, the entry naming the most fields wins, file order breaks a tie.

briefing.title: The Handover
card: Councillor Vale signed the clearance order for the marked block.
At shift handover he leaves the Civic Records Office for his official car.
We take him alive and bring him to our getaway car.
Quietly, if we can. Others want him too, and this city notices noise.
We have $100,000, four people and until 8:30.
briefing.objective: Take Councillor Vale alive to the getaway car.
briefing.win: Vale alive in the getaway car.

fails.vale-dead: Vale is dead. We needed him alive.
fails.vale-leaves: Vale left in his official car. We were too slow.
fails.rivals-reach-vale: The rival crew got to Vale first.
fails.sealed: The district sealed before Vale reached our car.
fails.enforcer-down: The Enforcer is down. Nobody else can carry Vale.
fails.entry-seen-guard: The guard saw the Enforcer go in. Vale was warned.
fails.entry-seen-camera: The entrance camera saw the entry. Vale was locked down.
fails.entry-seen-patrol: The patrol saw the entry. Vale was locked down.
fails.abduction-seen-camera: The pickup camera saw the take. Vale was rescued.
fails.driver-shot: The driver was shot. Security pulled Vale away.
fails.engine-error: Something broke in the works. The run is void.
fails.withdraw: The cell withdrew. The attempt is over.

clock.line: Handover chime at 5:30. At 8:30 the rivals take Vale or his car leaves.

purse.line: Purse: $100,000. Paying is dear; learning what people need is cheaper.

hints.front-door: Front door: Inez can draw the guard off. Blind the camera, then go in.
hints.pickup: Pickup: Vale's driver needs cash. Turn him before 5:40, take Vale at the car.

briefing.tracker: Take Vale alive to the getaway car · closes 8:30

cell.scout: Scout: watches, listens, misleads. Learns who people are.
cell.fixer: Fixer: asks, pays, helps, presses. Turns people and calls them in.
cell.tech: Tech: loops cameras and reroutes patrols from the control cabinet.
cell.enforcer: Enforcer: goes in, takes Vale, carries him. The only heavy.

waitress.name: Inez
waitress.about: Serves the café by the square. Said to be in debt.

driver.name: The driver
driver.about: Vale's official driver. Waits at the bay. Short of cash, they say.

guard.name: The guard
guard.about: Door guard. Takes his coffee at the café before he goes off shift.

councillor.name: Vale
councillor.about: Councillor. Signed the clearance order. Inside until the chime.

door.name: The public door
door.about: The Office's front door. The guard stands on it.

cabinet.name: Control cabinet
cabinet.about: Street cabinet. The Tech works the camera and the patrol from here.

camera-entrance.name: Entrance camera
camera-entrance.about: Watched by a person. Sees the public door and its steps.

camera-pickup.name: Pickup camera
camera-pickup.about: Watched by a person. Sees Vale's official car.

car-getaway.name: Getaway car
car-getaway.about: Our car. Vale goes in here.

car-official.name: Official car
car-official.about: Vale's car. The driver waits with it.

patrol.name: The patrol
patrol.about: A clockwork patrol sweeps the square. Gunfire turns it.

rivals.name: Rival crew
rivals.about: Another crew after Vale, on their own schedule.

security.name: Response unit
security.about: Officers sent when an alarm is called.

hostile.name: Hostile
hostile.about: Armed and in the fight. Shoot to stop them.

crowd.name: Passer-by
crowd.about: Just passing. They notice and remember what you do.

watch.label: Watch
watch.does: Learn where they go and when. No Trail, but it takes time.

onTarget.waitress: Learn Inez's rounds: door, tables, and when the guard drops in.
onTarget.driver: Learn the driver's routine: when he waits and when he moves.
onTarget.guard: Learn the guard's rounds: door, steps, and his coffee break.
onTarget.councillor: Learn when Vale moves. He stays inside until the chime.

listen.label: Listen
listen.does: Learn what they need and who they are. Stand close; it takes a while.

onTarget.waitress: Hear what Inez needs and how she'd take an offer. Stand close.
onTarget.driver: Hear what the driver needs and how he'd take an offer. Stand close.
onTarget.guard: Hear what the guard wants and whom he answers to. Stand close.
onTarget.councillor: Hear what Vale wants and who he answers to. Stand close.

mislead.label: False tip
mislead.does: Send the rivals the wrong way for a while. They may come back.

onTarget.rivals: Whisper the rivals a bad address. It buys minutes, not safety.

ask.label: Ask
ask.does: Ask outright. Free, but most refuse, and they remember you asked.

onTarget.waitress: Ask Inez outright. Free, but she'll likely refuse and remember.
onTarget.driver: Ask the driver outright. Free, but he'll likely refuse and remember.
onTarget.guard: Ask the guard outright. Free, but he may report you.

pay.label: Pay
pay.does: Slip cash for a favour. They'll owe you, but money leaves a trail.

onTarget.waitress: Slip Inez cash for a favour. She'll owe you, but money leaves a trail.
onTarget.driver: Slip the driver cash for the pickup. Money leaves a trail.
onTarget.guard: Slip the guard cash to look away. Money leaves a trail.

help.label: Help
help.does: Solve their trouble. Slower and dearer, but they remember it kindly.

onTarget.waitress: Clear Inez's debt. She'll remember it kindly, but it costs real money.
onTarget.driver: Cover the driver's cash trouble. He'll remember it, but it costs money.
onTarget.guard: Do the guard a kindness. Slow, but it can win him round.

pressure.label: Pressure
pressure.does: Lean on their trouble. Quick and free, but they'll fear and resent you.

onTarget.waitress: Lean on Inez's debt. Quick and free, but she'll fear you and may talk.
onTarget.driver: Lean on the driver's trouble. Quick and free, but he'll resent you.
onTarget.guard: Lean on the guard. Quick and free, but he is the Office's man.

call.label: Call
call.does: Call a turned contact to do their part now. Timing is everything.

onTarget.waitress: Inez spills coffee on the guard and draws him off the door for a while.
onTarget.driver: The driver parks across the pickup camera and blinds it for a while.

loop.label: Loop camera
loop.does: Freeze the entrance camera on one repeating minute. The Tech stays tied.

onTarget.cabinet: Work the cabinet: the entrance camera repeats one minute. You stay tied here.
onTarget.camera-entrance: Freeze this camera on one repeating minute. The Tech stays tied to the cabinet.

reroute.label: Reroute patrol
reroute.does: Send the patrol off its sweep on false orders. It comes back.

onTarget.cabinet: Work the cabinet: false orders take the patrol off its sweep for a while.
onTarget.patrol: Give the patrol false orders. It leaves its sweep, then returns.

enter.label: Enter the Office
enter.does: Go in for Vale by the public door. Seen on the way in, and it fails.

onTarget.door: Go in by the public door while the guard is away and the camera is blind.

take.label: Take Vale
take.does: Take Vale at his car. A watching camera or the rivals will ruin it.

onTarget.councillor: Take Vale at his car. A watching camera or the rivals will ruin it.

extract.label: Vale into the car
extract.does: Put Vale in the getaway car. It can't leave while a fight stands.

onTarget.car-getaway: Put Vale in the getaway car. It can't leave while a fight stands.

fire.label: Fire
fire.does: Shoot to stop them. The alarm goes up, and every hit adds Trail.

onTarget.hostile: Fire until this one is down. In the final fight no Trail is added.
onTarget.councillor: Never fire on Vale. Shooting the target fails the mission.

draw.label: Draw weapon
draw.does: Draw a weapon. Anyone who sees it may raise the alarm.

holster.label: Holster
holster.does: Put the weapon away. It doesn't undo what was seen.

cease.label: Cease fire
cease.does: Stop firing. The weapon stays drawn.

stance.label: Stance
stance.does: Choose when to fire: hold, return, or at will.

panic.label: Panic
panic.does: Everyone armed draws and fires at will. Only once a fight is on.

carry.label: Carry
carry.does: Lift a downed agent and walk them to the car. No firing, no running.

move.label: Walk
move.does: Walk there. Quiet, and the only pace while carrying Vale.

run.label: Run
run.does: Run there. Twice as fast, but anyone with a clear line notices.

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.does: Stop what this agent is doing now. Some stops cost you; read the line.

withdraw.label: Withdraw
withdraw.does: Call off the attempt. The cell gets away to try again.

cancelCosts.stop: Stops where they stand. Nothing is lost.
cancelCosts.holster: The weapon goes back. A draw already seen stays seen.
cancelCosts.cease: The firing stops. The weapon stays drawn.
cancelCosts.lost: The time is spent and nothing lands.
cancelCosts.aborted: The money comes back, but they remember the approach and your face.
cancelCosts.ends: The loop ends and the camera sees again.
cancelCosts.staff-report: Back out at the door without Vale. The staff report the intruder.
cancelCosts.quiet: Back out without Vale. Nobody is told.
cancelCosts.vale-reports: Vale is let go at his car and reports the attempt.
cancelCosts.put-down: They are laid down where the carrier stands.
cancelCosts.keeps-vale: Vale stays with the Enforcer. Putting him down is no cancel.
cancelCosts.down: A downed agent takes no orders.

acting.mislead: Giving the rivals a false tip

mission-over.line: The mission is over. Press Return to play again.

engine-error.line: The engine hit a fault. Restart the run.

unknown-verb.line: The engine doesn't know that order. Pick another.

agent-down.line: {op} is down. Another agent can carry them to the car.

enforcer-inside.line: The Enforcer is inside the Office. Wait for him at the service lane.

agent-busy.line: {op} is busy until {tick}. Wait, or use another agent.

guard-down.line: The guard is down. There is no one left to draw off.

guard-not-at-door.line: The guard isn't at the door. Call Inez while he is on post.

person-down.line: {who} is down. There is nothing more to do there.

person-away.line: {who} isn't out on the street yet. Wait for their routine.

no-place.line: No such place on the map. Pick a spot on the ground.

unwalkable.line: Can't walk there: a roof, a wall or a solid. Pick open ground.

no-walk.line: There's no way there from here. Pick another spot.

run-carrying-vale.line: Nobody runs while taking Vale. Walk him to the car.

run-carrying-downed.line: Nobody runs with a downed agent. Walk them to the car.

run-tethered.line: The Tech is tied to the cabinet while the loop holds. Wait for it to end.

only-scout.line: Only the Scout can do this. Select the Scout.

only-fixer.line: Only the Fixer can do this. Select the Fixer.

only-tech.line: Only the Tech can do this. Select the Tech.

only-enforcer.line: Only the Enforcer can do this. Select the Enforcer.

too-far.line: Too far from {who}. Walk within {m} m first.

needs-routine.line: Needs {who}'s routine first. Have the Scout Watch them.

needs-need.line: Needs what {who} needs first. Have the Scout Listen.

needs-temperament.line: Needs to know who {who} is first. Have the Scout Listen.

no-act-need.line: {who}'s need isn't one this approach can meet. Try another.

need-met.line: {who}'s need is already met. Nothing left to help with.

refusal-remembered.line: {who} refused this before. Try a different approach.

already-turned.line: {who} is already ours. Help keeps them; Call puts them to work.

no-cash.line: Not enough cash for the worst case ({usd}). Try a cheaper approach.

driver-too-late.line: Too late to turn the driver: his last turn was {tick}.

turn-needs-approach.line: Pick an approach: Ask, Pay, Help or Pressure.

vale-not-contact.line: Vale is the target, not a contact. He can't be turned.

not-a-contact.line: {who} isn't a contact yet. Turn them first.

car-gone.line: The official car has gone. It is too late to call the driver.

car-busy.line: The car is still moving until {tick}. Call again then.

call-too-late.line: Too late: the car leaves for the pickup at {tick}.

nothing-to-call.line: {who} has nothing to do on a call.

loop-wrong-target.line: The cabinet loops the entrance camera only.

loop-holds.line: The loop already holds. Nothing more to do.

stand-at-cabinet.line: Walk the Tech within {m} m of the control cabinet first.

patrol-down.line: The patrol is down. There is nothing left to reroute.

patrol-away.line: The patrol is already away until {tick}. Wait for it to return.

no-rivals.line: No rivals here yet. Wait for them to show.

stand-near-rivals.line: Walk the Scout within {m} m of the rival crew first.

vale-not-inside.line: Vale isn't inside. Entering works only while he is in the Office.

stand-at-door.line: Walk the Enforcer within {m} m of the public door first.

vale-not-at-car.line: Vale isn't at his car yet. Wait for him to come out.

stand-beside-vale.line: Walk the Enforcer within {m} m of Vale first.

no-vale-yet.line: The Enforcer doesn't have Vale yet. Take him first.

stand-at-getaway.line: Walk the Enforcer, with Vale, within {m} m of the getaway car.

car-held.line: The car can't leave while a fight stands. Finish it first.

no-weapon.line: {op} carries no weapon. Pick an agent who is armed.

already-drawn.line: The weapon is already drawn. Give a fire order.

not-drawn.line: No weapon drawn. Draw one first (F).

stance-unknown.line: A stance is hold, return or at will.

panic-not-cell.line: Panic is the whole cell's order, not one agent's.

panic-no-fight.line: Panic works only once a fight is on.

panic-nobody.line: Nobody armed is free to fire.

fire-running.line: Can't fire while running. Walk or stop first.

fire-carrying.line: Can't fire while carrying. Put them down, or let another shoot.

no-target.line: Nothing to fire at, or no clear line to a hostile in range.

fire-on-cell.line: The cell never fires on its own.

civilian-target.line: A civilian or a contact. Ctrl forces it, and the city will remember.

out-of-range.line: Out of range ({m} m). Walk closer first.

no-clear-line.line: No clear line. Move to where you can see them.

carry-vale.line: The Enforcer is already taking Vale. He can't carry anyone else.

carry-names-downed.line: Carry needs a downed agent to lift.

already-carried.line: Someone is already carrying that agent.

nothing-to-cancel.line: Nothing to cancel: this agent is idle.

keeps-vale.line: Putting Vale down is no cancel. Walk him to the car.

holstering.line: Holstering finishes in a moment. Nothing to cancel.

stand-beside-op.line: Walk within {m} m of the downed agent first.

needs-tier.line: {who} is only passing by. The cell has no hold on them.

needs-need-is.line: {who}'s need isn't one this order can meet.

needs-standing.line: The district doesn't see you that way yet.

needs-fit.line: {who} isn't the kind to answer this.

needs-trail.line: Not enough Trail has built up for that.

ack.trigger: an order is taken (the engine accepts it)

arrive.trigger: the agent has walked into reach and begins the act

done.trigger: the order lands (the engine logs scout.*, turn.*, loop.on, patrol.rerouted, rivals.misled, enter.out, take.done)
done.note: outcome on `turn`: how the approach went (turned, refused, not-yet, kept, suspicious)

reply.trigger: a turn order lands on a person: their answer, by the rulebook outcome (suspicious when the approach is reported)
reply.note: one answer per turn order; the contact's temperament picks the voice

confirm.trigger: the Fixer calls a turned contact: the contact confirms aloud (Chime voices it)

read.trigger: a Watch or Listen lands: the Scout says what the cell learned (Listen reveals need and temperament, Watch the routine)

taken.trigger: Vale is brought out (the Enforcer takes him at the car, or comes out of the Office with him)

start.trigger: the mission starts, cell at the getaway car

last-turn.trigger: the 5:40 last chance to turn the driver

rivals-arrive.trigger: the rival car parks near the pickup (or comes in on gunfire)

rivals-misled.trigger: a false tip lands: the rivals leave

guard-lured.trigger: Inez calls the guard: he leaves the door

guard-at-cafe.trigger: the guard reaches Inez: the coffee spill (the payoff cut)

guard-leaves-cafe.trigger: the guard starts back to the door

guard-back.trigger: the guard is back on the door

car-blocks.trigger: the driver's car crosses the pickup camera

car-clears.trigger: the car clears the pickup camera

car-leaves.trigger: the turned driver takes the car to the service lane

loop-ends.trigger: the loop ends (the Tech leaves the cabinet or goes down)

patrol-rerouted.trigger: the patrol takes the false orders

patrol-breaks.trigger: the patrol breaks its route to gunfire or a drawn weapon

run-seen.trigger: security sees an agent running: a found fault (Alert 1)

drawn-seen.trigger: a drawn weapon is seen (Alert 2 for security; a witnessed incident for people)

gunfire.trigger: a shot is seen or heard by people nearby

alarm.trigger: a report calls the response unit; the seal clock runs

going-loud.trigger: the going-loud card is committed: the first draw or shot that makes the run loud
going-loud.note: the host says it when the held commit completes

fight-loud.trigger: the final fight, loud: police come in

fight-safe.trigger: the final fight, safe: the rivals lie in wait at the car

fight-warned.trigger: a helped Inez warns the cell early
fight-warned.note: only when the engine says the warning came in time (FightWarned)

fight-guard.trigger: the guard, who never saw the cell, runs in against the rivals

fight-over.trigger: the last hostile is down; the car can go

ai-state.trigger: a hostile's AI state changes (Gun.St; the engine does not log it): outcome is the new state
ai-state.note: states routine, break, gone and down are silent here; see silentStates. Police holding is `hold`, the guard ally fighting is `engage` on the guard, the patrol engaging is `engage` on the patrol

ai-cover.trigger: a hostile takes a cover point

ai-break.trigger: more than half the rival crew is down: the rivals break for their car

ai-gone.trigger: a rival reaches the car and is gone

ai-join.trigger: the response unit on the street joins the loud fight

guard-stands-down.trigger: no foe in reach: the guard stands down

patrol-resumes.trigger: no foe in reach: the patrol turns back to its sweep

patrol-sweep.trigger: the patrol is back on its sweep

crowd-state.trigger: a passer-by's state changes (the crowd, GameScatter): startled, fleeing, sheltered, returning; `back` when they are on their way again
crowd-state.note: speak one passer-by near the cell per change, not each of the crowd; the cast by role (Inez, the driver, the guard, Vale) do not scatter

saw-gunfire.trigger: a person with a clear line to a shot remembers it (memory act saw-gunfire, taken at the shot before any startle)
saw-gunfire.note: no log code; the host speaks it when the memory is written. A questioned witness gives place and time from this memory (investigator.question)

agent-down.trigger: an agent is hit down (not the Enforcer: that is a fail)

win.trigger: Vale is in the getaway car

fail.trigger: the mission fails; outcome is the fail code

cliffhanger.trigger: the debrief: in the getaway car Vale names who is behind the order (Story spine, ending beat). outcome named = Halcyon (pending Sky), unnamed = the safe version

silentStates.routine: not yet in the fight: no line
silentStates.down: a hostile who is down speaks nothing

a shot (shot.hit, shot.miss): the tracer and the pips speak; no line per shot
the order echo (Game.Note "order.*"): the agent's own ack and arrive lines speak for it
a fire order's progress (fire.done, fire.lapses, fire.cancelled): bookkeeping; the shots speak through the fight events
witness bookkeeping; the visible reaction is gunfire, drawn-seen or run-seen
the fail text is the `fail` event, keyed by code
silentLogs.security.officer-down: an officer is hit: no line
silentLogs.security.hit: an officer is hit: no line
silentLogs.security.down: the response unit is down: no line
silentLogs.carry.lifted: the carry order's ack covers it
silentLogs.carry.missed: nobody to lift: the order's refusal covers it
silentLogs.mislead.missed: the rivals were already gone: no line
silentLogs.guard.hit: the guard is hit: no line
silentLogs.guard.down: the guard falls: no line (a downed guard speaks nothing)
silentLogs.patrol.hit: the patrol is hit: no line
silentLogs.patrol.down: the patrol is down: no line
silentLogs.rivals.hit: the rivals take a hit: no line
silentLogs.fight.hit: a hostile is hit: no line
silentLogs.fight.down: a hostile is down: no line
silentLogs.civilian.hit: a civilian is hit: no line (civilians are never the payload)
silentLogs.civilian.down: a civilian is down: no line
a cancel order's result (cancel.move, cancel.fire, cancel.draw, cancel.carry, cancel.<verb>): the cancel ack speaks; an Office or Vale report is the alarm event
silentLogs.enter.in: the Enforcer goes in: spoken by the enter order's ack and arrive
silentLogs.captured: a downed agent left behind: told in the debrief, not spoken
agent hit bookkeeping; the downing speaks (agent-down)
silentLogs.enforcer.down: the Enforcer down is a fail: spoken by `fail`

rules.source: briefs/011/motive-fights.md §8 (Motive); words by Fable; each line fits Glyph's 110 characters
rules.one: One at a time, in priority order (H1 first).
rules.once: Each fires once per run, and H hides the layer for good.
rules.idle: A hint shows only after the cell has given no order for 8 s.
rules.vanishes: It vanishes the moment its gone-when act happens, or when its trigger stops holding.
rules.words: Each line names an agent, a verb and a target, introduces one verb, and never names an approach, a time or a sequence.

H1.target: the people on the café terrace
H1.line: The door has a guard. The Scout can Watch the people on the café terrace.
H1.trigger: briefing closed, nothing learned about anyone, no Watch or Listen given
H1.rings: the café terrace (the place, not Inez)

H2.line: Watching shows where and when. The Scout can Listen, close by, to learn who someone is.
H2.trigger: a person's routine is known (Watch done), their need and temperament are not

H3.target: the person whose need is known
H3.line: The Fixer can turn this person. Hover an option to read its price.
H3.trigger: a person's need is known, they're not turned, and no approach has been given

H4.line: A camera watches the public door. The Tech can Loop it from the control cabinet.
H4.trigger: the entrance camera is live, the Tech is idle, and 0:45 has passed

H5.line: Turned people act on a call. The Fixer can Call them: right click to see what they do.
H5.trigger: a contact is turned and has never been called

H6.line: They refused, and they will remember. The Scout can Listen to learn who someone is.
H6.goneWhen: the next order to the Scout or the Fixer

H7.line: A patrol sweeps this door. The Tech can Reroute it, and N shows it coming round.
H7.trigger: the patrol's cone will cover the public door within the next 15 s, and the Enforcer stands within 10 m of it, not inside
H7.goneWhen: Enter, Reroute, or the Enforcer moving away

H8.line: Another crew watches the pickup. The Scout can give them a false tip.
H8.trigger: 3:10 has passed (the rivals have parked) and nobody has acted on them
H8.goneWhen: a Mislead order, or the Enforcer holding Vale

H9.line: Vale leaves by car. His driver waits at the pickup, and the Fixer can turn drivers.
H9.trigger: 4:00 has passed, route A isn't under way (no contact turned, no Enter), and the driver is unknown
H9.goneWhen: any order on the driver, or a contact turned

H10.line: Who covers the Enforcer on the way to the getaway car? Anyone armed can Fire.
H10.trigger: the Enforcer holds Vale, and no other armed operative stands within 15 m of the getaway car
H10.goneWhen: an armed operative within 15 m of the car, or a draw

H11.line: A downed agent left behind is captured. Select another agent and right click them to carry them.
H11.trigger: an operative is downed, the final fight is on or over, and nobody is carrying them
H11.goneWhen: a Carry order, or the extract

run-seen.trigger: the first `run.seen` of the run (Motive §8: shown on the next order)
run-seen.line: Security saw someone run and is looking into it (Alert 1).

goingLoud.captured: Anyone downed is captured unless carried.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: A tip, then. A bad one.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Let the money do the talking.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: A kindness. Leave it with me.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: I know where it hurts. Sorry.
I don't like this. Doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: Sending it the long way round.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: This is yours, if you'll have it.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: I hear you're in a spot.
Let me take that off you.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Let's be honest, you and I.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: Holding. Don't ask me to move.
It sees the same minute, forever.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: Patrol's off its sweep. Not for long.

dialogue.speaker: enforcer
lines: Inside. Tell me if that changes.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Good. They trust us a little more.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Inez works the café door. Never leaves.
Tables, counter, door. Round and round.
The guard stops by her door for coffee.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: The driver waits in the car for Vale.
Never leaves the bay. Polishes the badge.
Car at the bay. Engine warm.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Guard on the public door. Coffee soon.
Door, steps, door. Café before he goes.
He sweeps the steps, then back.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale stays in. Out at handover.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: A debt. Proud. Cash would insult her.
Owes a lender. Won't be bought. Kindness works.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: A debt. She'll sell her time to anyone.
Owes a lender. Money talks to her.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: A debt. The lender scares her.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: A debt. Loyal to the café. Slow to trust.
Owes a lender. Sticks to the rules.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Short of cash. Won't take a bribe.
Needs money. Proud. Help, not pay.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Wants cash. The price is the only question.
Needs money and doesn't hide it.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Short of cash. Nervous about his post.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Needs cash. Still the Office's man.
Short of money, but loyal to the post.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: He can be paid. He always has been.
A bonus man. Takes from anyone.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Office man through and through. He reports.
Loyal to the Office. Don't approach him.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale believes in the Council. Won't bend easily.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale has a price. They all do.
He'll bargain the moment he can.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale's frightened of something. Not us.
He keeps glancing round. Someone scares him.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Right. For the block. Watch the door.
For the neighbours. Here I go.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: I'm on the clock now. Watch the door.
Our deal. The guard is mine for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Okay. Okay. I'll do it. Be quick.
I'll spill it. Don't let him see me shake.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: I know him. I'll keep him busy.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Car's moving. Good luck, all of you.
Across the lens it goes. Be quick.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Car's across the lens. Clock's ticking.
Parked where you wanted. Mind the time.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: It's in place. Don't be long.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Nobody can fault where I've put it.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: You will answer to the Council for this.
Take your hands off a Councillor.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Name your figure. I'll double it.
Whoever pays you, I pay more.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Please! I'll sign anything you like.
Don't hurt me. I've done nothing.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: This is a government building. Out.
You have no right to be here.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Whatever you want, it can be arranged.
Let's talk terms before anyone is hurt.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: No! Please, no. Don't touch me.
Who are you? What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: A favour? From strangers? Not yet.
Come back when you've earned a yes.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Anything for the block. What do you need?
If it helps people, I'm in.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Not here. I'll be telling someone.
Don't ask that twice. People listen.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Favours cost. Ask again with money.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: No! I can't. Please go away.
I... no. Leave me out of it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: All right, all right. Only go.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: That isn't allowed. I'll have to say.
I'll be reporting this, I'm afraid.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Keep your money. I'm not for sale.
Put that away. It's an insult.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: A bribe? I'll tell someone. I will.
Take your envelope elsewhere. I'm telling.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Now we're talking. What do you need?
Count it twice. Then I'm yours.
Cash is kind. Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Fine. I'll take it. Tell no one.
Quickly, before someone sees the envelope.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: I'm obliged to report this. Whatever it was.
That goes in my log. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: You paid my debt? I'm yours. Say when.
Nobody's ever done that. Whatever you need.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: That's twice. I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Even your kindness is a threat. I'll talk.
Charity from you? I'll be telling someone.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: That's a start. Is there more?
Down a bit. Not all of it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: All of it? You've bought a friend.
Debt's gone. So is my price.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Still good for it. I'll remember.
More? I could get used to this.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Thank you. But it's not enough yet.
Some of it. I'm still so frightened.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: It's really gone? Thank you. I'll help.
I can breathe. Tell me what to do.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: You keep helping. I feel safer.
Thank you. I won't forget this.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Kind of you. I must think it over.
A good start. I'll consider it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: You stood by me. I'll stand by you.
The owner would approve. Count me in.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: You keep your word. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Even a favour gets reported, I'm afraid.
Help is still an approach. I must log it.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: You'd use my debt against me? Fine.
That's cruel. I'll do it. Once.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Threats? I'll tell everyone I know.
You'll be reported, you and your threats.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: All right, all right. No need to be nasty.
Business, then. I'll do it. Once.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Please. Don't. I'll do whatever you say.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: I'll tell the owner exactly what you said.
A threat? That goes in the book.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Give me a reason, not a favour.
Ask me why first. Then ask again.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: If it keeps people in their homes, yes.
For the block? Count me in.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Careful. I could tell the Office.
Don't ask that here. People report.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Nothing for nothing. Bring cash next time.
My time's paid for. Yours isn't.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: No. I'll lose my post. No.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: All right! Anything. Stop looking at me.
Yes, yes. Only don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: I drive the Councillor. Nothing else. Noted.
Move along, friend. This goes in my log.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: I can't be bought. Not even by you.
Keep your money. Find someone cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: A bribe? I'll tell the Office.
Put it away, or I report you.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Deal. Where do I put the car?

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Put it away! Someone's watching! Yes, fine.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: I report bribes. Even polite ones.
Keep that. This goes in my log.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: That's decent of you. The car is yours.
My wages, covered? Then I'm with you.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Decent again. I'm in this with you.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Don't help me. I'll have to report it.
Kindness from you? I don't trust it.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: A first instalment. I'll wait for more.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Paid in full. The car's yours.
That settles it. Where do I park?

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: You pay well. I remember that.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Some of it. But what if I'm caught?
Thank you. It's not enough yet.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: I can cover it now. I'll do what you ask.
You've saved me. I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: You look after me. Thank you.
I sleep better since you came.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Generous. I need a moment to decide.
A little more, and I'm yours.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: The Office won't hear it from me.
You came through. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Reliable of you. I'll note that.
A steady friend. I won't forget.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Help from strangers? I'll write it down.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: You're no better than the city. Fine.
I hate this. I'll do it once.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: I'll see you reported for this.
Threats? The Office will hear of it.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: No need for that. Name the job.
Threats don't raise my price. Fine.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Please, no! I'll drive wherever you say.
Don't hurt me. I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Say that again for the officer.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Free favours don't pay my rent.
Talk to me with an envelope.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: State your business or move along.
You're loitering at an Office door. Move.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: The envelope's heavy. I'm looking away.
I never saw you. A pleasure.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Bribing an officer. Name and address?
That's a report I owe the Office.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: You've got me. What do you want?

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Kind. But I still serve the Office.
I'll think it over. Come back.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: The Office comes first. After you, though.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: A steady friend. I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Unusual help. I'll note the time.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: All right. I know when I'm beaten.
No need. I can be sensible.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: A threat to an officer. Reported.
You'll answer for that to the Office.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale's inside. The door is quiet.
The square looks ordinary. That's the trouble.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Nobody gets hurt today. That is the plan.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: I'll find the cabinet. Cameras first.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Shift's over. The doors are open.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: There's the chime. Time to be ready.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Last chance to turn the driver.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Vale's out. Walking to his car.
There he is. Alone. Heading for the car.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: He's at the car. Now or never.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Home, please. It's been a long day.

dialogue.speaker: rivals
lines: Eyes on the door. Wait for him.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: The shooting woke the rivals. They're coming.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: A spill at the café? Coming.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Oh! I'm so sorry. Your coat!
Clumsy me. Sit, I'll fetch a cloth.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Guard's with Inez. The door is open.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Guard's leaving the café. Clock's running.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Car's in the way. Camera's no use now.
Parked just so. Nobody sees a thing.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: Pickup camera's blind. The window is open.

dialogue.speaker: driver
lines: Service lane, Councillor. Quieter that way.
Taking the car round to the lane.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: The driver's moved the car. Service lane.
He's taken it round the back.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: Left the cabinet. The feed is live again.
Loop's gone. The camera sees again.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: The loop's off. Watch the lens.

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: It took the orders. It always does.
Patrol's gone. Fixed routines are easy.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Hold it! No running in the square!

dialogue.speaker: patrol
lines: Citizen. Walking is encouraged. Running is reported.

dialogue.speaker: watcher
lines: Camera two. Runner at the steps.
Runner by the Office. Log it.

dialogue.speaker: security
lines: Runner on the square. Eyes open.
Why is he running? Watch him.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Weapon! Drop it! Drop it now!

dialogue.speaker: watcher
lines: Gun on camera! Call it in!
Camera two shows a weapon. Alarm!

dialogue.speaker: security
lines: All units. Shots at the Records Office.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: They're coming. The cordon next. Hurry.
The clock's running. We have minutes.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Alarm's up. They'll seal the district.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: Rivals! By the car! Look out!

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Armed men! Not in my square!

dialogue.speaker: tech
lines: The feeds are clean. For now.
The cameras never saw us. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Do you know who I am?

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: He's dead. We needed him breathing.
No. No. That was never the plan.

dialogue.speaker: enforcer
lines: A dead man is no use.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: His car's gone. We were too slow.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Home. And not a word to anyone.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: They've sealed the district. We're stuck.
The cordon's closed. No way out.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Our heavy's hit. We can't finish.
He's down. Nobody else can carry Vale.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: He's hit. We can't take Vale without him.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: The guard saw him. Vale's warned.
Too soon. The guard was back.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: The camera caught him at the door.

dialogue.speaker: watcher
lines: Camera one. Intruder at the door.
Entrance camera shows a breach. Lockdown!

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: The patrol saw him go in.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: The pickup camera caught it all.
Seen at the car. Vale's rescued.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Not the driver. We never meant that.

dialogue.speaker: councillor

lines: The clearance wasn't mine. Halcyon wrote it.
Halcyon pays the Council. The next list is signed.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
dialogue.pending: pending Sky: Halcyon is a Story proposal (the-suborned-story-v0.1, ending beat). Ship `unnamed` until Sky decides.
lines: Get me safe and I'll name them. Halcyon.
Halcyon bought my signature. The next list is ready.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
dialogue.pending: pending Sky: Halcyon is a Story proposal (the-suborned-story-v0.1, ending beat). Ship `unnamed` until Sky decides.
lines: Halcyon! They sent those men to silence me!
It was Halcyon. The next list is already signed.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
dialogue.pending: pending Sky: Halcyon is a Story proposal (the-suborned-story-v0.1, ending beat). Ship `unnamed` until Sky decides.
lines: Halcyon. Then we have somewhere to start.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: The clearance wasn't mine. Someone paid for it.
Someone owns the Council. The next list is signed.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: Get me safe and I'll give you the name.
Someone bought my signature. The next list is ready.

dialogue.speaker: councillor
lines: They sent those men to silence me!
It was never my plan. The next list is signed.

dialogue.speaker: fixer
lines: Someone paid for it. And the next list?
Then we have somewhere to start.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: To my post! Cover the door!

dialogue.speaker: rivals
lines: Too many down! Back to the car!

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: Half of them are down. They're running.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: Quiet again. Back to the door.

dialogue.speaker: patrol
lines: Sweep resumed. Have a pleasant day.
Route restored. Thank you for walking.

dialogue.speaker: scout
lines: The patrol is walking its round again.

dialogue.speaker: crowd
lines: Is it over? Is it safe?

dialogue.speaker: crowd
lines: I saw it all. Every bit.

dialogue.speaker: waitress
lines: I saw it. I saw everything.

dialogue.speaker: guard
lines: I saw the shooter. I'll know him.
